signals.text: Dowman to miss three matches after appeal rejected. Arsenal's Max Dowman will miss three matches after an appeal against his sending-off during Tuesday's loss at Fleetwood is rejected.

'He knows his role' - Man City penalty hero Rulli still Donnarumma deputy. Geronimo Rulli's penalty shootout heroics may have put the pressure on Gianluigi Donnarumma at Manchester City, but manager Enzo Maresca has no doubt about his number one.
